image_description: A close-up, macro shot of sliced meatloaf. The image features two prominent slices in the foreground with a glossy, reddish-brown glaze on top. The interior texture is visible, showing ground meat mixed with green flecks (likely peppers or herbs) and lighter specks (onions/breadcrumbs). In the background, out-of-focus green beans and yellow squash are visible, suggesting a plated meal context.

To assess the realism of the food textures, lighting, and glaze reflections, which are critical for food photography authenticity.
To check for structural coherence in the meat mixture and ensure no 'melting' artifacts at the boundaries of the glaze and meat.
To verify that the background elements have consistent geometric depth and do not warp into the foreground subject.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'green flecks' inside the meat. In AI images, these often look like smudged paint rather than distinct vegetable pieces. Also, verify if the glaze looks like a liquid layer sitting on top or if it merges unnaturally with the meat crust.
